threats.title: Approval bypass
threats.description: An action proceeds without backend-approved permission or reuses a stale approval.
threats.controls: Backend-enforced approvals, safe defaults, stale and duplicate approval rejection.

threats.title: Authentication handoff abuse
threats.description: Handoff leaks credentials or allows unauthorized provider access.
threats.controls: Backend auth handoff, logout clearing state, credential hygiene assertions.

threats.title: CI gate drift
threats.description: CI stops validating the mission or weakens existing security hardening.
threats.controls: Validator in existing Windows CI, pinned actions, no weakened assertions.

threats.title: Loss of user work
threats.description: Crash, restart or recovery discards uncommitted user changes.
threats.controls: Recovery state machine, resume preserving partial responses, no destructive reset.

threats.title: Document and machine state drift
threats.description: Requirements, acceptance criteria or evidence diverge from the frozen mission.
threats.controls: Deterministic validator, frozen manifest, ADR on change.

threats.title: Event corruption
threats.description: Malformed, partial, duplicate or stale events corrupt session state.
threats.controls: Normalization, schema version, sequence, dedup, correlation, isolation.

threats.title: Command or script injection
threats.description: User or Jcode input reaches a shell, script or dynamic eval.
threats.controls: Shell-free spawn, argument separation, environment allowlist, no remote script piping.

threats.title: Incompatible license
threats.description: License forbids use or requires obligations no one has approved.
threats.controls: License verification, explicit approval for AGPL, BUSL and source-available licenses.

threats.title: Autonomous loop drift
threats.description: The loop performs unapproved work without gates or limits.
threats.controls: Finite retry limits, circuit breakers, role separation, human-controlled gates.

threats.title: Orphaned child process
threats.description: Cancellation or crash leaves a child process running.
threats.controls: Graceful cancellation, forced termination, Windows process-tree termination, orphan cleanup.

threats.title: Unreviewed open source
threats.description: Mutable releases, unattributed code, forced dependency, unknown license.
threats.controls: OSS adoption policy with provenance fields and forbidden practices.

threats.title: Output leak into unexpected channel
threats.description: Jcode stdout/stderr or diagnostics leak into the UI or logs without redaction.
threats.controls: stdout/stderr contracts, bounded separators, diagnostic redaction.

threats.title: Path traversal
threats.description: Symlink or junction escape reads or writes outside the workspace.
threats.controls: Canonical path resolution, junction escape protection.

threats.title: Child process escape
threats.description: Spawned process escapes the intended working directory or tree.
threats.controls: Canonical paths, working directory validation, process-tree termination, orphan cleanup.

threats.title: Protocol instability
threats.description: Jcode protocol or event schema changes without a versioned contract.
threats.controls: Frozen schema, sequence numbers, deduplication, protocol stability tests.

threats.title: Resource exhaustion
threats.description: Unbounded buffers, concurrency, queues, cost or memory starve the host.
threats.controls: Bounded buffers, backpressure, timeouts, concurrency and resource limits, cost controls.

threats.title: Secret exposure
threats.description: Credentials reach logs, events, Git, CI, localStorage or React state.
threats.controls: Secret redaction, credential hygiene, no credentials in Git, CI and events.

threats.title: Supply chain compromise
threats.description: Downloaded runtime or dependency is not the verified official artifact.
threats.controls: Official repo verification, pinned versions, checksum verification, atomic install.

threats.title: Untrusted n8n workflow
threats.description: Workflow contents include credentials, code, URLs, MCP servers or prompt injection.
threats.controls: Treat as untrusted input; never execute, import, connect or copy blindly; n8n research gate.
